line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.5.6: Fixes an edge case if the player has no outposts. Pick a player sector with the least support. If the player has no sectors, tell the player to get a sector.
* Create a new array! The items are not necessarily sorted. The indices of both the outposts and specs must have corresponding index!
* Player doesn't have an outpost; get a player sector instead.
* Add-Ons 1.5.6: Moved 18 second delay to before updating mission prompt. This avoids transients. (1.8.1: Added Xenon Defect variant messages.)
* Add-Ons 1.3: No tutorial version of the message on insane mode.
* Add-Ons 1.4.13: Calculate the grade of the set of blueprints determined at game start. Present a score to hint the player how good their set will be.
* Add-Ons 1.7.4: Color the score depending on strength.
* The player does not have a valid sector. Tell the player to acquire one and then he'll be contacted again.
* Calculate the grade of the set of blueprints determined at game start. Present a score to hint the player how good their set will be.

line.text: 'You currently do not have any sectors. Acquire a sector and the OCV will contact you again.'
